about: The limits of the cost gate of the search listing (direction 40). The test listing-cost.test.ts measures the UTF-8 bytes of the JSON that the model reads. searchListingBytes is the list of the three search tools, exactly. worstTaskShare is a ceiling: the most bytes of one task (the search listing, one search_tools result and one describe_tool result for a query of search.golden.json), as a share of the list of each tool of the dev-tools server.
